naya.title: Smart Brain v3 Hardening — Naya Note
naya.summary: The Smart Brain hardening pass turns the memory architecture into an enforced operating system: deterministic indexes, executable CI validation, reliable tests, hybrid retrieval, verified CIS artifacts, and explicit evidence boundaries.
lessons: A constitution becomes operational only when code and CI enforce it.
Derived indexes must be deterministic so repository state can be proven clean.
Verification must be stronger than confidence: repair data and validators rather than weakening the gate.
Canonical events are source truth; indexes are derived views; receipts are evidence.
next_best_actions: Verify the post-repair CI run is green.
Advance toward true vector/embedding retrieval and measure recall/precision.
Automate verified Daily/Weekly/Monthly CIS compounding and feed receipts.

human.title: Smart Brain v3 Hardening — Shawn Note
human.summary: We are moving from a well-designed Smart Notes system to a genuinely enforced Superbrain. It must be organized, retrievable, verifiable, testable, and able to compound learning instead of depending on a future AI to remember the rules.
lessons: The system has to prove it works, not just describe how it should work.
Time organizes memory, meaning connects it, indexing retrieves it, and verification earns trust.
Every meaningful execution should leave the brain stronger than it was before.
next_best_actions: Confirm the CI gate is green after the hardening repairs.
Keep pushing the brain toward faster, deeper, more accurate recall and automatic compounding intelligence.
